description: T-3666: Excel's date names under every BCP-47 locale tag of MS-LCID and CLDR, one row per tag. Each cell joins with CHAR(31): the tag, mmm and mmmm of the 12 months of 2023, ddd and dddd of 2023-01-01 (a Sunday) to 01-07, AM/PM of 0.25 and 0.75, A/P of 0.75 and yyyy-mm-dd of 45000. A tag Excel does not know prints the en-US names with "P" for A/P.
